versions.localizedDescription:
uiux小调整；安卓低版本登录修复与性能优化；安卓14+预测性返回（可关闭）；ios 换 xcode27 打包。

### What's Changed

* Android 单栏预测性返回与设备圆角（v0.10.1） by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/212
* fix(android): 修复回答横滑误返回，让预览从起手侧露出 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/218
* 增加可切换的信息流性能模式，并记录 Android 8.1 实测 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/223
* 修复 Windows 本地 Release 包冷启动时的 Sentry 模块缺失 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/220
* 修复 Android 8 平板冷启动后无法恢复登录的问题 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/221
* 修复 Android 8 登录恢复，优化正文加载与信息流滚动 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/222
* 固定「最近发布」顶栏并简化翻页控件 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/224
* 统一自绘顶栏返回按钮，补齐文章和游客预览的返回入口 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/225
* 调整回答详情顶栏显隐，增加滚动条越界压缩效果 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/226
* 支持整张底部面板下拉关闭，优化弹出动效 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/227


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/compare/v0.10.0...v0.10.1

### What's Changed

* 下拉刷新不清空已加载列表内容 by @duofuwang in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/193
* fix: 个人主页分页拼接时按 id 去重 by @NobetaSena in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/198
* 完善划线评论、选区操作与富文本阅读 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/200
* 稳定折叠回答卡片的滚动位置，直接展示同题问题详情 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/201
* fix: 预览列表模式下点回答卡片不发起标题过渡 by @NobetaSena in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/202
* 为「我的」页添加随滚动收起的头像和模糊封面 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/205
* fix: 展开问题描述时不再闪出灰色占位条 by @NobetaSena in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/203
* 修复 Android 下拉刷新手势，调整 iOS 为 42 个等距齿位 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/206
* 改善 iOS 双栏弹窗，支持知乎扫码登录和无图模式 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/207
* 长图文正文分批渲染，优先显示首屏 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/208
* 让「我的」页头像随滚动融入灵动岛和相机挖孔 by @huamurui in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/210

### New Contributors
* @duofuwang made their first contribution in https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/pull/193

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huamurui/zhihu-minus-minus/compare/v0.9.10...v0.10.0
